message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model estimates parameters that maximize the likelihood of observing the training data, and predictions are made by thresholding the estimated probabilities.
